title: Bill Clinton's 'tar baby' remark to Rockefeller at the ranch

tellings.quote: He told Rockefeller it's like the story of the uh tar baby.

plain: In 1995, at the Wyoming ranch of the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller, President Bill Clinton is said to have told Rockefeller that the UFO question was like the story of the tar baby, an old folk tale about a sticky figure that traps whoever touches it. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells this without naming a source, as a sign that the president saw the subject as something he could not touch without getting stuck.
